questions.solution_text:
The curve lies to the left of the $y$-axis, so the integral is negative.
$-\int_{0}^{3}\left(-2y\right)dy$
$= -\left[-y^{2}\right]_{0}^{3}$
$= -\left(-9\right)$
$= 9\ \text{units}^{2}$
